title: Quality Studio rule applicability
description: Which rule packs decide a project's rule set, read from .quality/rules/applicability.json (project scope) or <data root>/rules/applicability.json (global scope). The most specific file wins. Present, it replaces the house-style default: a rule applies when one of the packs selects it. Absent everywhere, the built-in house-style pack applies.

packs.description: Pack ids known to this repository: built-in, global or project. An empty list selects no rule; only overrides then enable rules.

reason.description: Why these packs describe the project.
